Field Name
Description
Note: While these descriptions are robust and drive a helpful console experience, we encourage you to not use
this field to drive workflows, as values are updated and added regularly.
DetectName
Detection name.
DetectId
The Detection ID for the detection. Can be used in other APIs, such as Detection Resolution and ThreatGraph.
Example: "ldt:05c0273d48f2432271b2f1d1b49264b5:4297692922"
HostGroups
Contains the comma separated list of Host Group IDs.
Tactic
The name of the tactic associated with the behavior.
Tags
Contains comma separated list of FalconGroupingTags and SensorGroupingTags.
Technique
The name of the technique/sub-technique associated with the behavior.
Objective
The name of the objective associated with the behavior.
PatternDispositionDescription
The description of the pattern associated with the action taken on the behavior.
PatternDispositionValue
The numerical ID of the pattern associated with the action taken on the behavior. See
.
DnsRequests{}.CausedDetect
True/false – indicates whether the Domain lookup triggered the detect.
DnsRequests{}.DomainName
Domain Name from DnsRequest events.
DnsRequests{}.RequestType
The DNS request type. For more information on DNS request types, see DNS Constants on MSDN.
DocumentsAccessed{}.FileName
Name of file accessed.
Note: A detect Summary can have 0 or more DocumentsAccessed_FileName entries and there is a timestamp for
each DocumentsAccessed_FileName entry.
DocumentsAccessed{}.FilePath
File path, if a document was accessed.
Note: A detect Summary can have 0 or more DocumentsAccessed_FilePath entries.
DocumentsAccessed{}.Timestamp
Time the document was accessed in Unix epoch time.
ExecutablesWritten{}.FileName
Name of executable file that was written.
Note: A detect Summary can have 0 or more ExecutablesWritten_FileName entries and there is a timestamp for
each ExecutablesWritten_FileName entry.
ExecutablesWritten{}.FilePath
File path where executable file was written.
Note: A detect Summary can have 0 or more ExecutablesWritten_FilePath entries.
FalconHostLink
Link to view detection event in Falcon console.
FileName
File name if a file is involved in the detection.
FilePath
File path if a file is involved in the detection.
GrandparentCommandLine
The command line used to create the grandparent process.
GrandparentImageFileName
Grandparent image file name.
IOARuleInstanceID
Numerical ID of the custom IOA rule under a given CID. This field is included for an event when a custom IOA rule
triggers the detection.

Field Name
Description
IOARuleInstanceVersion
Version number of the InstanceID that triggered. This field increments when the rule is revised or updated and is
included for an event when a custom IOA rule triggers the detection.
IOARuleName
Name given to the custom IOA rule that triggered. This field is included for an event when a custom IOA rule
triggers the detection.
IOARuleGroupName
Name of the rule group that the rule belongs to. This field is included for an event when a custom IOA rule
triggers the detection.
IOCValue
The CrowdStrike Intelligence indicator that triggered the detection. Example: baddomain.com
IOCType
The type of the indicator. Possible values are: domain, filename, hash_md5, hash_sha256, registry_key,
command_line, behavior.
LocalIP
Local IP address.
MACAddress
MAC address.
MD5String
MD5 hash.
MachineDomain
The Windows Domain Name to which the machine is currently joined.
NetworkAccesses{}.AccessTimestamp
When network access activity occurred in Unix epoch time.
NetworkAccesses{}.AccessType
Network access type.
NetworkAccesses{}.ConnectionDirection
Whether the connection is inbound (1), outbound (0), or neither (2).
NetworkAccesses{}.IsIPV6
Where the network access is IPv6.
NetworkAccesses{}.LocalAddress
Local IP address.
NetworkAccesses{}.LocalPort
Local port of a network connection, as the normal port number. (for example, an incoming ssh connection is 22).
NetworkAccesses{}.Protocol
RFC-1700 IP protocol identifier.
NetworkAccesses{}.RemoteAddress
Remote IP address.
NetworkAccesses{}.RemotePort
Remote port.
Nonce
64-bit unsigned integer nonce associated with the detection.
OverwatchNotes
Overwatch notes.
ParentCommandLine
The command line used to create the parent process.
ParentImageFileName
Parent image file name.
ParentProcessId
Parent Process ID.
PatternDispositionFlags
List of all patterns and their state of association (true/false) with the current action.
PatternId
The numerical ID of the pattern associated with the action taken on the detection.
ProcessEndTime
Timestamp of when a process ended in Unix epoch time.
ProcessId
Process ID.
